claim: The new DEFAULT-unwrapping check for `resolveThemeValue` requires the resolved value to be an array, so it never matches the plain-object namespace values it is meant to handle, meaning `theme('shadow')`-style CSS lookups on a namespace with only a bare `DEFAULT` value fall through and return `undefined` instead of the string.
evidence:
typeof resolvedValue === 'object' &&
      resolvedValue !== null &&
      Array.isArray(resolvedValue) &&
      'DEFAULT' in resolvedValue
